text:
All change-spec sections for run `20261104-101757-feature-new-entity-former-names` have been written and validated under `.sdlc/runs/20261104-101757-feature-new-entity-former-names/change.sections/`:

- **`header.json`**: Defines repo conventions, 5 architectural decisions (annotation constant/syntax, `search` table indexing via `FORMER_NAME_SEARCH_KEY = 'formerrefs'`, live-entity precedence + conflict resolution + permission checks, OpenAPI `/entities/by-former-name/{kind}/{namespace}/{name}` + `CatalogApi.getEntityByFormerRef`, and React Router `location.state.redirectedFrom` notice flow), 2 file checks (`format`, `test`), and 6 project checks.
- **`units-001.json` (`U01`–`U10`)**: `@backstage/catalog-model` (`ANNOTATION_FORMER_NAMES`, `FieldFormatEntityPolicy` validation, API report) and `@backstage/plugin-catalog-backend` (`buildEntitySearch` indexing, `EntitiesCatalog.entityByFormerRef`, `DefaultEntitiesCatalog`, `AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog`, `openapi.yaml`, OpenAPI codegen tooling step, and `createRouter`).
- **`units-002.json` (`U11`–`U25`)**: `@backstage/catalog-client` & `@backstage/plugin-catalog-react` (`CatalogApi.getEntityByFormerRef`, `CatalogClient`, `InMemoryCatalogClient`, `catalogApiMock`, API reports), `@backstage/plugin-catalog` (`catalogTranslationRef`, `useEntityFromUrl`, `EntityRenamedNotice` in legacy `EntityLayout`, alpha `EntityLayout`, and alpha `EntityLayoutBui`), `@backstage/plugin-techdocs` (`techdocsTranslationRef`, `useExternalRedirect`, `TechDocsReaderPage`), and the `yarn build:api-reports` tooling step.
- **`units-003.json` (`U26`–`U31`) & `units-004.json` (`U32`–`U38`)**: Unit/integration tests across all five modules and documentation in `docs/features/software-catalog/well-known-annotations.md`.
